text: なにが　うまれて　くるのかな？

structure.jp: うまれて　くるのかな？

patterns.name: 〜てくる
patterns.explanation: The て-form plus くる shows something coming out toward you or coming into being. うまれて　くる = 'will come out, be born'.

patterns.name: 〜のかな
patterns.explanation: のかな at the end means you are wondering to yourself about something. くるのかな = 'I wonder what will come'.
